exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Silent Storm original painted UI texture 5111, complete 38 by 46 pixel UV canvas.
Input image: edit target is a nearest-enlarged RGB-only view of the ORIGINAL COMPLETE texture. It is the exact geometry and material reference, not an inspiration image.
Primary request: faithfully refine only the original painted surface into an HD texture. Preserve every existing shape and the complete original canvas. Keep the original aspect ratio 38:46, canvas framing and all normalized UV coordinates EXACTLY. Return the full image edge-to-edge, without fitting the painted object into another aspect ratio, padding, crop, rotation, relocation or redesign.
Subject and invariants: The source is one small dark grey matte metal slider frame with one black inset. Inside are exactly TWO orange arrows: one points UP in the upper half and one points DOWN in the lower half, their tips separate and their shape and spacing exactly match the source. Preserve the full rectangular frame, original little metal highlights, dark edge shading, orange shade and original empty black surround. No extra arrow, cross, numeral, screw or ornamental detail.
Materials: keep the source's quiet fine grain and original broad shading. Do not enlarge the pattern or turn the texture into polished chrome, dramatic scratches, chunky grain or outlined decoration. Match original material and soft highlights. Brightness will be calibrated numerically later; preserve the relative source shading.
Constraints: every region remains at its existing UV location and size. Keep the exact original number and geometry of details. Black empty/cut-out areas remain black. This is a plain painted GAME TEXTURE, not a scene or product rendering. Return opaque RGB; the source alpha is restored separately. No text, fonts, labels, logos, flags, portraits, invented symbols, decorative curls, screws, extra hardware, new cells or grids. No artificial transparent cut-out or color fringe. No artistic additions. Only refine the existing painting.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Source RGBA to native RGB only, exposing original stored RGB, nearest8x full canvas without crop/rotation/UV fitting. Original variable alpha preserved separately by root final pack. No inpainting/unpremultiplication/art insertion.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in argument including original CRLF equals UTF-8 prompt file bytes without trailing newline. Reference paths portable equivalents of actual absolute repo paths.
native_alpha_source: Original source alpha LANCZOS4x; checked byte-identical in private native preview. Root final pack responsibility.
